Home.title: Find rooms your groups can actually book.
Home.subtitle: Search Falco’s current hotel inventory by stay dates. See open room quantities, review each property, and request a private agency rate.

Home.coverageTitle: One search for the cities on your group itinerary.

Home.stepsTitle: From stay dates to a confirmed allotment
Home.stepOneCopy: Enter check-in and check-out. Availability is checked for every night, not only the first.
Home.stepTwoCopy: Review hotel photos, room capacity, distance, and the quantity available for those dates.
Home.stepThreeCopy: Tell us how many rooms you need. Falco confirms the private rate and assigns the rooms after agreement.
Home.stepsNote: Have split dates or more than one hotel? Send us the complete itinerary.
Home.availableTitle: Rooms open for your full stay
Home.closeTitle: Start with the dates. We’ll help with the room plan.
Home.closeCopy: Search current availability or send the complete itinerary for a multi-hotel stay.
